ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity dominance; predominantly black/dark-grey pixels with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at lateral extremities and sparse circular mid-tone rings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (dark) field across >95% of visible fluke area. High-contrast white clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Multiple low-contrast, circular grey ring motifs (approx. 10-12) are scattered across the central ventral surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 50-degree angle at the visible vertex, though the base is partially obscured by splash/water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along both lobes. The left lobe tip displays deep, irregular macro-notches (3-4 distinct jagged peaks). The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a series of smaller, more uniform serrations (peaks approx. 5-10 pixels in amplitude relative to local baseline).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following a generally parabolic arc from the central notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular spots concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes (barnacle colonization). Multiple faint circular ring scars distributed centrally on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation at both lobe tips. Multiple circular depigmented rings ('cookie-cutter' style marks) on the ventral surface. Significant irregular jagged erosion/tissue loss at the distal tip of the left lobe.
